info.description: A production-grade RESTful API for international e-commerce platforms with multi-currency support, timezone-aware operations, and enterprise-level architecture.
info.title: Global E-commerce Microservices API

get.description: Check if the API and its dependencies (database, redis) are operational with detailed metrics
Returns API version, build date and commit hash
Get a list of all active supported currencies for the platform

200.description: data: array of currencies, total: integer

get.description: Performs a real-time currency conversion using the latest exchange rates

parameters.description: Amount to convert (must be a positive number)
parameters.name: amount

get.description: Get a paginated list of the authenticated user's order history.

post.description: Create a new order with multi-currency support. Validates stock and captures current exchange rates.

parameters.description: Order payload including items and shipping address
parameters.name: request

400.description: Validation Error (Invalid JSON, empty items, invalid UUIDs)

get.description: Retrieve an order by its human-readable tracking number (e.g., ORD-2025-000123).
Retrieve complete details of a specific order by UUID. Enforces ownership (user can only see their own orders).

404.description: Order not found or belongs to another user

put.description: Transitions an order to a new status (e.g., from confirmed to shipped).

400.description: Validation Error (Invalid JSON or invalid state transition)

get.description: Get a paginated, filtered, and sorted catalogue of products. Supports multi-currency pricing display.

parameters.description: Display prices converted to this ISO 4217 currency code
parameters.name: currency

parameters.description: Search products by name or SKU
parameters.name: search

parameters.description: Filter products with price greater than or equal to this amount
parameters.name: min_price

parameters.description: Filter products with price less than or equal to this amount
parameters.name: max_price

parameters.description: If true, only return products with stock > 0
parameters.name: in_stock

post.description: Creates a new product in the catalogue. Requires administrator privileges.

400.description: Validation Error (e.g., duplicate SKU, missing fields)

get.description: Retrieve complete details of a specific product by its UUID.

parameters.description: Convert price to this currency (default: USD)
parameters.name: currency

put.description: Modifies mutable fields (name, description, price) of an existing product.

delete.description: Performs a soft-delete on a product, removing it from the public catalogue.

get.description: Retrieve the authenticated user's profile information based on their JWT token

put.description: Update authenticated user's profile information. All fields are optional (partial update).

400.description: Validation Error (e.g., Invalid JSON or Currency)

delete.description: Perform a soft-delete on the authenticated user's account

get.description: Retrieve any user's profile by their UUID. Intended for administrative use.

latency_ms.description: Int format for v1 detailed monitoring

services.description: Kept as "services" to avoid v2 breaking changes

BearerAuth.description: JWT Authorization header using the Bearer scheme. Example: "Bearer {token}"
BearerAuth.name: Authorization
